name: east-farmyard
notes: Three independent closed timber buildings with thick pitched roofs and completed backs.
Eleven individually oriented sheep with wool bodies, heads, ears, tails and four legs.
Reference coordinates and stipulated Y=.06 foundation datum retained.
Parent terrain must meet the component base datum.
Inherited mountain obstructs some sheep; completed-ground evidence shows the unobstructed component.
Terrain, roads, lamps, vegetation and neighboring architecture remain owned by parent/siblings.
Reference softness, roof patina and shared lighting remain approximate.
